tools.name: PowerShell 7
tools.location: MSIX under Program Files\WindowsApps (forced to C:, about 120 MB)
tools.purpose: Modern cross-platform shell and the default Windows Terminal profile.
tools.when: Default interactive shell for all Windows work. Use Windows PowerShell 5.1 only for legacy scripts.
tools.agentNotes: Run scripts with pwsh -NoProfile -File. The profile lives in Documents\PowerShell (Documents is redirected to D:). The 5.1 profile is separate.

tools.name: Windows Terminal
tools.purpose: Terminal host: One Half Dark scheme and the IosevkaTerm Nerd Font face, both identical to the Acer; Tokyo Night Storm kept as an extra scheme.
tools.when: Every interactive session. The Dell stays on 1.24 on purpose.
tools.agentNotes: settings.json is merged by 20-apply-configs.ps1 from configs\terminal\toolkit-fragment.json. Do not hand-edit defaults; machine profiles are preserved.

tools.name: Starship
tools.purpose: Cross-shell prompt. One starship.toml for Windows and both WSLs.
tools.when: Always on in PowerShell. Check the config with starship print-config.
tools.agentNotes: STARSHIP_CONFIG points to ~\.config\starship.toml. The managed profile block initialises it once per session.

tools.name: IosevkaTerm Nerd Font Mono
tools.location: per-user fonts: %LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\Windows\Fonts (54 TTF files in two sets, about 760 MB, C:, cannot be redirected); Acer has it system-wide
tools.purpose: Glyph font for Starship icons. Two sets from one archive: the normal set (Terminal face IosevkaTerm Nerd Font, GDI name IosevkaTerm NF) and the Mono set (IosevkaTerm NFM, used by VS Code).
tools.when: Windows Terminal face is IosevkaTerm Nerd Font (same as the Acer). VS Code terminals use IosevkaTerm NFM. Both sets are installed.
tools.agentNotes: No winget package exists. Source is Nerd Fonts v3.5.1 IosevkaTerm.tar.xz with a pinned SHA-256.

tools.name: zoxide
tools.purpose: Smart directory jumper that learns frequent folders.
tools.when: Use z <part-of-path> instead of cd for folders you visit often.
tools.agentNotes: Initialised once by the managed profile block. Agents should not rely on z in non-interactive shells.

tools.name: fzf
tools.purpose: Fuzzy finder for files, history and command output.
tools.when: Ctrl+T files, Ctrl+R history, Alt+C folders (through PSFzf), or pipe any list into fzf.
tools.agentNotes: Interactive tool. Agents should use rg or fd directly, not fzf.

tools.name: PSFzf
tools.location: PowerShell Gallery module in Documents\WindowsPowerShell\Modules and Documents\PowerShell\Modules (Documents is on D:)
tools.purpose: Gives fzf its PowerShell key bindings (Ctrl+T, Ctrl+R, Alt+C).
tools.when: Loaded automatically by the managed profile block when the module exists.
tools.agentNotes: Never enable -EnableAliasFuzzySetLocation: it defines an alias named fd that shadows fd.exe.

tools.name: fd
tools.purpose: Fast, friendly replacement for find.
tools.when: Find files by name. It respects .gitignore and the global ignore file.
tools.agentNotes: Global ignore file is %APPDATA%\fd\ignore. Use -H -I to see hidden and ignored files.

tools.name: bat
tools.purpose: cat with syntax highlighting and git change markers. Also the fzf preview renderer.
tools.when: View a file in the terminal. Use --plain for copyable output.
tools.agentNotes: Config is %APPDATA%\bat\config. For reading a file in an agent session prefer the agent's own Read tool.

tools.name: delta
tools.purpose: Readable git diff and git log -p pager.
tools.when: Automatic after the shared git include is applied. Bypass with git --no-pager.
tools.agentNotes: Agents should call git --no-pager so output stays plain.

tools.name: Git
tools.location: C:\Program Files\Git (about 400 MB, installer is Inno Setup)
tools.purpose: Version control. Windows global config is shared by the toolkit.
tools.when: Windows-side repos only. Projects live in WSL ext4, never under /mnt.
tools.agentNotes: core.autocrlf is input. Identity and safe.directory entries are machine specific and are never touched.

tools.name: GitHub CLI
tools.purpose: GitHub from the terminal and the git credential helper for github.com.
tools.when: PRs, issues, auth. gh auth status shows the login without printing the token.
tools.agentNotes: Never print gh auth token. The credential helper is gh auth git-credential.

tools.name: ripgrep
tools.purpose: Fast recursive text search.
tools.when: Search file contents. It respects .gitignore.
tools.agentNotes: Preferred over grep or Select-String for large trees.

tools.name: jq
tools.purpose: Query and reshape JSON.
tools.when: Inspect JSON from APIs, logs and config files.
tools.agentNotes: Use for JSON files that hold secrets only with a filter that prints names, never values.

tools.name: FFmpeg
tools.location: winget portable full build (about 200 MB, C:)
tools.purpose: Audio and video conversion.
tools.when: Convert, trim or extract media.
tools.agentNotes: Always pass -n or -y explicitly so it never prompts.

tools.name: NanaZip
tools.purpose: The one archive tool (replaces WinRAR). Supports 7z, zip, tar, xz, rar extraction.
tools.when: Open or create archives from Explorer. Use tar.exe for tar.xz in scripts.
tools.agentNotes: No stable console executable on PATH. Scripts use the built-in tar.exe (bsdtar).

tools.name: Node.js LTS
tools.location: C:\Program Files\nodejs (about 100 MB, kept on C: because MCP configs reference it)
tools.purpose: JavaScript runtime for npx, MCP servers and CLI tools.
tools.when: Always. LTS 24 matches both WSL installs.
tools.agentNotes: The Dell moves from 22 to 24 through 11-node-lts-swap.ps1 (by hand). npm cache is D:\npm-cache via ~/.npmrc.

tools.name: npm
tools.purpose: Node package manager and the carrier of global CLIs (Codex, mcp-remote).
tools.when: Install or update global CLI tools.
tools.agentNotes: Global packages live in %APPDATA%\npm and survive a Node major upgrade.

tools.name: pnpm
tools.location: winget portable (tiny, C:). Corepack stays disabled because enabling it needs admin under Program Files
tools.purpose: Fast disk-efficient JavaScript package manager.
tools.when: JavaScript projects that use a pnpm-lock.yaml. Projects themselves live in WSL.
tools.runsWhere: Windows (WSL has its own via Corepack)
tools.agentNotes: Do not run corepack enable on Windows.

tools.name: uv
tools.location: %USERPROFILE%\.local\bin (tiny, C:). Cache is D:\Cache\uv through UV_CACHE_DIR
tools.purpose: Python project, tool and interpreter manager (standalone installer, supports uv self update).
tools.when: All Python work. The pip copy in C:\Python313 is retired after this one is verified.
tools.agentNotes: Machine PATH precedes user PATH, so the pip uv wins until Python is removed by 04-admin-remove.ps1 -IncludePython.

tools.name: uv-managed Python
tools.purpose: Python interpreter installed and owned by uv instead of a system install.
tools.when: uv picks it automatically for uv venv and uv run.
tools.agentNotes: There is no python.exe on PATH after the Chocolatey Python is retired. Use uv run python or a project .venv.

tools.name: winget
tools.purpose: The package manager for everything on Windows.
tools.when: Install or upgrade tools. Always pass --exact and --source winget.
tools.agentNotes: A portable package may install without a PATH entry. Check Get-Command <tool> afterwards.

tools.name: Claude Code
tools.purpose: Primary agent CLI for terminal and vault work.
tools.when: Coding, file work and vault tasks from a shell.
tools.agentNotes: Settings and MCP registry belong to Build 6. This toolkit only verifies the binary.

tools.name: Codex CLI
tools.location: npm global in %APPDATA%\npm (small, C:); packages junction at D:\Cache\codex\packages
tools.purpose: OpenAI agent CLI.
tools.when: Second-opinion coding runs and sandboxed tasks.
tools.agentNotes: Pinned to the version recorded in toolkit.lock.json. Daemon needs .codex\packages\app-server-daemon\current to exist.

tools.name: Claude Desktop
tools.location: per-user app (forced to C:), VM bundle under %APPDATA%\Claude
tools.purpose: Chat app with MCP servers and Cowork.
tools.when: Conversational work with MCP-connected tools.
tools.agentNotes: Configured MCP server names are listed in the catalog. Values are never read.

tools.name: Cursor
tools.purpose: AI-first code editor.
tools.when: Editor sessions with its agent.
tools.agentNotes: Cursor sessions are archived by the Jarvis Cursor pipeline.

tools.name: Antigravity
tools.purpose: Google agent IDE.
tools.when: Agent-first editor sessions.
keyCommands: Command Palette > Install 'agy' command in PATH (one-time)
tools.agentNotes: The agy shim exists only after the one-time in-app step.

tools.name: Docker Desktop
tools.location: C:\Program Files\Docker; disk image on D:\WSL\Docker
tools.purpose: Container engine. Needed by Dev Containers and some MCP servers.
tools.when: Container and Dev Container work. Auto-start is off by choice.
tools.agentNotes: If the engine pipe is missing, Docker Desktop is not running. Start it, do not reinstall.

tools.name: Ollama (Windows)
tools.location: D:\Apps\Ollama (Dell); models in D:\AI\ollama-models via OLLAMA_MODELS
tools.purpose: Local model runtime.
tools.when: Local models. On the Dell a WSL Ollama currently holds port 11434 (Build 5 decides which serves).
tools.agentNotes: ollama --version may print the WSL server version while the Windows client differs. The startup shortcut stays until Build 5.

tools.name: VS Code
tools.location: per-user installer (Dell on C:, Acer on D:\Apps)
tools.purpose: Main editor. Settings, extensions and MCP wiring belong to Build 6.
tools.when: Editing, remote-WSL and remote-SSH work.
tools.agentNotes: Settings Sync is live. Never write Windows VS Code user files from a script in this build.

tools.name: mcp-remote
tools.purpose: Bridge for remote HTTP MCP servers that only speak stdio to a client.
tools.when: A client config uses npx mcp-remote <url>.
tools.agentNotes: May not print a version; presence on PATH is the check.

tools.name: npx
tools.purpose: Runs Node-based MCP servers without installing them.
tools.when: MCP config entries of the form npx -y <package>.
tools.agentNotes: Resolves only if Node is on PATH.

tools.name: uvx
tools.purpose: Runs Python-based MCP servers and tools in isolated environments.
tools.when: MCP config entries of the form uvx <package>.
tools.agentNotes: Comes from the standalone uv, not the pip uv.

tools.name: Docker CLI
tools.purpose: Command used by MCP servers shipped as containers.
tools.when: MCP config entries of the form docker run.
tools.agentNotes: Only the command resolution is verified; the engine may be stopped.

tools.name: Tailscale (Acer, Windows side)
tools.purpose: Tailnet client used by the Acer to SSH into the Dell's WSL.
tools.when: Remote-SSH to the canonical host (dell-wsl).
tools.agentNotes: Never installed by a script. Never inside the Acer's WSL.

tools.name: Yazi
tools.purpose: Terminal file manager with the Tokyo Night Storm flavor.
tools.when: Browse files inside WSL.
tools.agentNotes: Windows Yazi is not part of this toolkit.

tools.name: lazygit
tools.purpose: Git TUI wired to delta.
tools.when: Stage, commit and rebase interactively in WSL.
tools.agentNotes: Interactive only.

tools.name: tmux
tools.purpose: Terminal multiplexer, Ctrl-a prefix, resurrect and continuum.
tools.when: Long-running sessions over SSH.
tools.agentNotes: Agent status plugins show per-pane agent state.

tools.name: atuin
tools.purpose: Shell history search, local only.
tools.when: Ctrl+R in WSL bash.
tools.agentNotes: History can hold secrets typed on the command line. Never print it.

tools.name: sesh
tools.purpose: tmux session manager that uses zoxide.
tools.when: Jump between project sessions.
tools.agentNotes: Interactive only.

tools.name: ncdu
tools.purpose: Disk usage browser.
tools.when: Find what fills a WSL folder.
tools.agentNotes: On Windows use WizTree instead.
